title: The Relevant question in the exam
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：relevant　|　正文 346 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 relevant 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the headmaster wrote of ① a relevant question in the exam in the record, and everybody in the school said at once that it was ② so relevant that nobody in the school would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the headmaster, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the relevant ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the relevant question in the exam that anybody there had ever seen, or so the record for October 1957 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too relevant to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the student who had come to help; the relevant ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bell at the far gate, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a relevant detail of the case, and said that no student in his right mind would call it ⑥ as relevant as the detail of the case they had once had in the old school. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was relevant or not, and he said so.

By 1970 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the record. What the line asked for was ⑦ something relevant, and nothing besides. The student from the next school called the whole plan ⑧ quite relevant; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the record kept the names of the relevant ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1973, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another relevant question in the exam in the same record, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less relevant than anybody had expected. ⑩ The relevant detail of the case that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1975, was the one she could never quite name; the relevant ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 相关（前置定语 a relevant question in the exam：1963 年校长在学籍册里记下的那件相关的问答）
B. adj. 相关／切题（两处加强说法：so relevant that … 与 no less relevant than …）
C. adj. 相关／切题（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 相关（表语 too relevant to do：母亲觉得它太相关，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 切题（前置定语 a relevant detail of the case：叔叔把整件事称作一桩切题的相关细节）
F. adj. 切题（同级比较 as relevant as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩案子的相关细节相比）
G. adj. 切题（后置定语 something relevant：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 切题（受程度副词修饰 quite relevant：那位学生的评价）

items.q: a relevant question in the exam
the relevant question in the exam that
a relevant detail of the case
The relevant detail of the case that

answers.why: relevant 意为“相关”，1963 年校长在学籍册里记下的是“一件相关的问答”，此处作前置定语 a relevant question in the exam。
relevant 意为“相关”，此处用 so relevant that 结构，说它相关到学堂里没人敢靠近。
relevant 意为“相关”，学籍册上 十月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的相关考卷上切题的问答，等于最高级的说法。
relevant 意为“相关”，母亲认为这件东西“太相关了，谁也用不上”，too relevant to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
relevant 意为“切题”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩切题的相关细节”，此处作前置定语 a relevant detail of the case。
relevant 意为“切题”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩案子的相关细节一样切题”，同级比较用 as relevant as。
relevant 意为“切题”，学籍册上那半行字要的是“切题的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something relevant。
relevant 意为“切题”，邻学堂来的那位学生认为这套计划“相当切题”，quite 修饰原级 relevant。
relevant 意为“切题”，no less relevant than 表示“其切题不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之切题不亚于任何人的预料。
relevant 意为“切题”，母亲 1975 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的切题相关细节”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1963 年，校长在学籍册里记下了一件相关的问答。（a relevant question in the exam）
它相关到学堂里没有一个人敢靠近。（so relevant that …）
母亲觉得它太相关，谁也用不上。（too relevant to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩切题的相关细节。（a relevant detail of the case）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩案子的相关细节一样切题。（as relevant as …）
到了 1970 年，学籍册上只剩半行字：要的是一件切题的东西。（something relevant）
answers: In 1963 the headmaster wrote of a relevant question in the exam in the record.
It was so relevant that nobody in the school would go near it.
My mother thought it too relevant to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a relevant detail of the case.
He said nobody would call it as relevant as the detail of the case they had once had.
By 1970 the record asked for nothing but something relevant.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 relevant 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1963 the headmaster wrote of a relevant question in the exam in the record, and nobody forgot it.
It was the relevant question in the exam that anybody there had ever seen, or so the record says.
My mother thought it too relevant to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a relevant detail of the case, and nobody argued with him.
The student from the next school called the plan quite relevant, and everybody laughed.
The relevant ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
